strings: r_c0 tells m_c that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} lucky to have regained any eyesight at all. Hopefully, {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} sight won't degrade any further.
m_c stalks out of the medicine cat den and nearly runs into another cat, which only increases {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} frustration at the news that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyesight won't be getting better.
m_c closes {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyes and opens them again a few moments later, trying to get a sense of just how bad {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} eyesight is now.
